title: A Fiancé for Christmas
description: A single woman opens a fake wedding registry, hoping a shopping spree would cheer her up. When the registry is discovered, she's too embarrassed to tell the truth. Instead, she finds a fake fiancé to help her navigate the holiday festivities.

title: Christmas Plus One
description: Sisters Cara and Amy make a pact to find their soulmates by next Christmas.

title: Engaged by Christmas
description: Hoping to save her relationship before the holidays, Zoe seeks help from an advice columnist named Adora. However, when her boyfriend breaks up with her, Zoe tracks down Adora to confront her, only to discover he's actually a man named Adam.

title: A Runaway Bride for Christmas
